The '''20th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 1962, were held on March 5, 1963.

==Winners and nominees==
[[File:Gregory Peck 1948.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Gregory Peck]] won for ''[[To Kill a Mockingbird (film)|To Kill a Mockingbird]]'']]
[[File:Geraldine Page by Roy Schatt circa 1950s.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Geraldine Page]] won for ''[[Sweet Bird of Youth (film)|Sweet Bird of Youth]]'']]
[[File:Marcello Mastroianni 54.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Marcello Mastroianni]] won for ''[[Divorce, Italian Style]]'']]
[[File:Rosalind Russell - 1950.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Rosalind Russell]] won for ''[[Gypsy (1962 film)|Gypsy]]'' ]]
[[File:Legendary Hollywood actor Omar Sharif.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Omar Sharif]] won for ''[[Lawrence of Arabia (film)|Lawrence of Arabia]]'']]
[[File:Studio publicity Angela Lansbury.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Angela Lansbury]] won for ''[[The Manchurian Candidate (1962 film)|The Manchurian Candidate]]'']]
